- `prefix` (string) - Key prefix for uploaded bundle files (default "treadmark/").
  Interpolate build variables in HCL for per-image prefixes, e.g.
  "treadmark/${local.name}/".

- `region` (string) - AWS region; empty defers to the default config chain.

- `endpoint` (string) - Endpoint override for S3-compatible stores (MinIO etc.).

- `force_path_style` (bool) - Use path-style addressing (usually wanted with endpoint overrides).

- `storage_class` (string) - Storage class; empty means the service default (STANDARD).

- `sse` (string) - Server-side encryption: "", "AES256", or "aws:kms".

- `kms_key_id` (string) - KMS key id/arn used when sse = "aws:kms".

- `include_image` (bool) - Also upload the input image artifact (off by default; note S3
  PutObject caps single objects at 5 GiB).
